intro.heading: Welcome to myNextDays.
intro.p1: Powerful global distribution technology combined with a property management system built exactly for your size of business.
intro.p2: Increase your occupancy, simplify daily work and create great guest experiences — without the complexity of systems designed for large hotels.
intro.p3: With everything in one place, smart automation and seamless connections to the most important booking channels, your business grows with more control and less effort.
intro.reichweite: We support more than 53,000 properties worldwide.
intro.zitat: Working with you was the answer to our problems. We modernised our administration and the service we give our guests.
